relation_design.annotation: Assistant-designed relation labels with explicit reading assumptions; not independently adjudicated.
relation_design.source: Recombine words and expression patterns seen in official Train. The resulting pairs and labels are newly designed, not official labels.
relation_design.focus: Genuine restriction F/B versus meaning-preserving structure changes E, with argument/role/event N contrasts.
relation_design.development: Error families were selected using Dev analysis; Dev text is only a rejection blacklist during preparation.

augmentation.audit_scope: Vocabulary isolation is for NEW MANUAL rows; old scope and copied Train are separately disclosed.

training_order: all Row CE batches, then all Pair CE batches
selection: best Dev pair-aware weighted F1; earliest epoch on ties
row_ce_exposure: each train row once per epoch, including all N singletons
pair_ce_exposure: each real pair once per epoch; no N term in three-combination Pair CE
comparison_note: Mixed vs staged changes batching, update count and forward exposure as well as loss schedule; not a pure shuffle ablation.
shuffle: Row and Pair loaders shuffle rows/groups every epoch. Mixed loader shuffles whole groups, preserving the two paired rows.

shuffle_generators.row: global torch RNG as historical staged recipe
shuffle_generators.pair: global torch RNG as historical staged recipe
